title: Irembo — National ID
text: Apply for or renew a national ID through Irembo (irembo.gov.rw). You need a valid phone number and payment via Mobile Money or bank.

title: Irembo — Birth certificate
text: Request a birth certificate on Irembo. Processing times vary by sector; keep your application reference number.

title: RRA — Pay tax
text: Rwanda Revenue Authority (RRA) taxes can be paid via Irembo, banks, or Mobile Money. Use your TIN for all filings.

title: RRA — EBM receipts
text: Registered businesses must issue EBM receipts. Consumers can verify receipts on the RRA verification portal.

title: Police clearance
text: Police clearance certificates are requested through Irembo. Allow several working days for processing.
